blocks.html: Rico J. Puno and Marco Sison will perform at Robinsons Magnolia and Robinsons Novaliches, respectively on Sunday, September 11. Both performers are well revered for their numerous classic hits. For Rico J, songs like “Macho Guwapito”, “Kapalaran”, “May Bukas Pa” and “Memories” will surely entertain Rob Magnolia’s weekend patrons. “Si Aida or Si Lorna or Si Fe”, “Always”, “My Love Will See You Through”, on other hand, are included in Marco’s song list for his concert at the Trade Hall of Robinsons Novaliches.
